thread:
Clara (Content): Quick heads up
We finished the Elm Street Labs interview. Raw clips + a 75s hero marked. Need a clean hero quote, legal ok, and the HubSpot routing before we push the announcement and webinar CTA.

Raj (PMM): Sweet. Paste the one-liner you want on the landing and I'll draft the three-line deck and social copy. Also propose webinar date?

Bea (Producer): Raw + rough cut here: https://redwood.app/drive/elmstreet-raw. Hero clip timestamp: 00:30-01:45. We need final quote by Friday COB to keep the 2/11 publish and 2/18 webinar cadence.

Ivy (AE): Elm Street wants initial demo leads from the CTA to go to their Solutions inbox, then fallback to our regional AE after 36h. Also they want campaign=elm_q1_2026 and owner tag in the payload.

crm-bot: Please provide routing string as comma-separated key=value pairs. Example: lead_source=case_study,owner=team-x.

Ivy (AE): Use: lead_source=elm_case,owner=elm-solutions,fallback_owner=redwood-emea-ae,followup_delay=36h,campaign=elm_q1_2026

Marco (Legal): I scanned the transcript. Two redlines: 1) they used a specific cost fold number  (we should redact and replace with qualitative language unless they confirm); 2) one technical vendor mention needs removal. Send the proposed hero and I'll sign off quickly.

Clara (Content): Proposed hero quote (redacted): "Redwood helped us reduce inference costs while accelerating our release cadence."

Raj (PMM): I like that. For stronger framing: "Redwood helped us reduce inference costs and accelerate our release cadence across teams." Slightly tighter.

Marco (Legal): That phrasing is OK. Approving with vendor redacted. Marco (Legal) :white_check_mark:

Bea (Producer): Copy. I'll hand the approved quote to design and prep the hero cut. Clara, can you confirm byline and consent to use a before/after chart? Elm Street agreed to a qualitative before/after but not raw numbers per legal.

Clara (Content): Byline: "Samir Khan, CTO, Elm Street Labs". Chart note: we'll use a schematic before/after labelled "improved efficiency" and "faster releases" (no numbers). Tagging @Marco once placed.

Ivy (AE): Confirmed. Also, please include a hidden tracking token in the CTA payload so Elm's ops can filter inbound leads in their CRM. Use token=elm_launch_0226.

crm-bot: Confirm payload accepted. Routing rule queued to staging. Reminder: deploy to production 60 minutes before publish window.

Raj (PMM): Webinar plan: propose 2/18 for a joint customer webinar: 30min demo + 15min Q&A. We'll use the case page CTA to register and set the CTA to route leads as above. Bea, can you draft the webinar landing copy and send speaker bullets?

Bea (Producer): On it. I'll draft speaker bullets and request headshot + short bio from Samir. Also creating a cutdown clip for social (30s).

Marco (Legal): Once the landing has the quote + schematic, re-tag me and I'll do a final quick pass.

Clara (Content): Thanks team. Final checklist: quote approved by legal, routing in staging, design working on art, webinar scheduled. I'll drop the final landing copy into the doc tonight and ping for final sign-off tomorrow morning. :rocket:
